title: Fed-ISIC2019 communication impairment robustness benchmark
purpose: Evaluate robustness of tuned Fed-ISIC2019 federated algorithms under cross-silo availability, compression, message-drop, additive-noise, and combined impairments.
execution: one condition per launch; all configured algorithms are run together in one benchmark() call

selected_hyperparameters.purpose: Clean-baseline selected hyperparameters for Fed-ISIC2019 Experiment 2 and Experiment 5 runs.

selection_notes.metric: Primary tuning metric is server balanced accuracy; validation loss is the tie-breaker.
selection_notes.future_main_experiment_trials: Use 3 trials by default after hyperparameters are selected; consider 5 only if compute budget allows.
selection_notes.client_participation: Full participation over the six natural Fed-ISIC2019 centers.
selection_notes.communication: No drops, no noise, no compression.
selection_notes.fednova_variant_selection: Selected server momentum only: use_momentum=false, use_server_momentum=true, use_prox=false.
selection_notes.fedlt_variant_selection: Selected Adam local solver with an intermediate learning rate/rho candidate after comparing previous best, retune best, middle, and lr=0.001 diagnostic curves.
selection_notes.fedopt_family_selection: Selected FedAdam over FedYogi and FedAdagrad.
selection_notes.feddyn_note: FedDyn remained hard to tune under the available budget; the selected green diagnostic candidate is the most plausible tested option but should be interpreted cautiously.

loss: WeightedFocalLoss(gamma=2.0, alpha=FLamby Fed-ISIC2019 weights by default)

network.cross_silo_rationale: Cross-silo FL usually defaults to full participation because the number of institutions is small and coordination is more controlled than in cross-device FL.
network.availability_rationale: Cross-silo clients are generally assumed to be available and stable, but temporary unavailability can still happen due to maintenance windows, system failures, or connectivity incidents. This experiment therefore tests a high availability rate, UniformActivationRate(0.80).
